cohort_finding_summary: Negative-control case. The 2022-03-31 10-K (FY2021) is a PURE commercial space-based cellular thesis. Zero Pentagon programs, zero PE numbers, zero named DoD customers, zero AST Defense subsidiary activity disclosed at this PIT. pentagon_jbook returns NOT_FOUND for AST SpaceMobile and AST & Science as contractors; usaspending returns zero DoD obligations. The J-Book divergence pattern is non-applicable and the filing's silence on defense matches external reality — no manufactured DoD narrative exists to be unmasked. The framework correctly classifies this as a non-signal: zero false positives generated from the J-Book primary verifier.
